settings.quote: NVIDIA didn't just build a better chip; they built the language of AI.

settings.label: THE CORE ADVANTAGE
settings.heading: Parallel Processing
settings.text: A CPU is like a very smart professor who can solve one hard problem at a time. A GPU (NVIDIA's specialty) is like a stadium full of students who can each solve a very simple addition problem at the exact same time. For AI, you need millions of simple calculations at once, making the GPU the perfect engine.

settings.label: THE MOAT
settings.heading: The CUDA Ecosystem
settings.text: NVIDIA created CUDA, a software layer that allows developers to talk to the hardware. Over the last 15 years, almost every AI researcher has learned to use CUDA. If they switch to a different chip, they have to learn a new language. That is a massive 'switching cost'.

settings.company_summary: The world leader in AI computing and the creator of the GPU.
settings.intro_note: This digest explores how a company that started by making video games look better became the most important infrastructure provider in the world.
